en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small domed Byzantine-style Orthodox church with ornate brickwork and a cross on top, located along a street with a fence and adjacent multi‑storey building with balconies. In the street there is a horse‑drawn or early motor tram with several people around it, and other small houses and trees in the background. Greek text captions appear at the bottom, along with a website watermark.
